<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Rystem.PlayFramework</id>
    <version>10.1.1</version>
    <authors>Alessandro Rapiti</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>rystem.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <description>Rystem.PlayFramework helps you to use concepts like multi agent and openai.</description>
    <releaseNotes>Version aligned to 10.1.0-beta.5 for compatibility with Rystem.PlayFramework.Adapters 10.1.0-beta.5. This release does not change PlayFramework runtime behavior; use the matching adapter version for the Azure OpenAI v1 and OpenAI 2.12.0 migration.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>2024</copyright>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/KeyserDSoze/Rystem/tree/master/src/AI/Rystem.PlayFramework" commit="af95611e3175e0cadb86ac1659d2d4f65ce9618c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" version="10.9.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="OpenTelemetry" version="1.18.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="OpenTelemetry.Api" version="1.18.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting" version="1.18.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Rystem.DependencyInjection" version="10.1.0-beta.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Rystem.RepositoryFramework.Abstractions" version="10.1.0-beta.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
    <frameworkReferences>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <frameworkReference name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.App" />
      </group>
    </frameworkReferences>
  </metadata>
</package>
